SELECT p.id, p.device_id, d.code AS device_code, d.name AS device_name, p.maintain_type, p.cycle_days, p.last_date, p.next_date, p.remark FROM eqp_maintain_plan p LEFT JOIN eqp_device d ON d.id = p.device_id WHERE p.deleted = 0

AND p.next_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
ORDER BY p.next_date IS NULL, p.next_date ASC, p.id DESC
